response.overview: Belong / Pertenecer follows the path of a family forced to flee their home and their struggles to navigate the system while rebuilding their identity in a new country. Some of us came with nothing but luggage of fear and longing. Some of us were running away from something and/or looking desperately for something else, sometimes home won’t let you stay. How do we rebuild our identity in order to survive in a new country? Belong is made of two words: be and long.
response.title: Belong
